statement: 在完整2595-record step12000评估确认 continuation 同时回退、step10000仍为最佳后，用户针对‘保留10k为parent并改变fidelity mechanism、先做严格小样本pixel-fidelity gate’明确回复 yes, lets do this now, any idea?，随后再次提醒必须先审计旧五类 predicted-clean→frozen-VAE→RGB 路径为何未转化成Blur指标、确认正确后只为10k Blur parent做严格小样本消融。现批准执行 reports/flux2_blur_pixel_fidelity_authorization_v1.json 和冻结 config：同一step10000 parent、同一数据/随机流、fresh optimizer的flow-only对照与flow+RGB-MSE候选各400步；冻结VAE，无refiner/decoder tuning；development仅描述性评估且不选arm/weight/checkpoint；禁止Qwen degradation conditioning、mixed degradation、sealed internal、official FoundIR test；不自动full-scale。该记录是最新USER明确授权，不是捏造advisor回复。
